title: The Void Has a Sense of Humor
logline: When Jesus shows up and finds a crying Twitter user running from the void, he walks right up to it, makes it laugh so hard it coughs up galaxies, and gently offers the user something scarier than the void: someone who really wants to know how they are; and in a bonus memory, the void quietly kicks a depression magician across the room so it can have one peaceful moment with my fear.

voice_notes.NARRATOR: The storyteller, the 'I', the same voice as the earlier film: telling a ridiculous thing they imagined to one friend, late, half laughing. Warm, a little wry, close to the mic. Part One is playful hypothetical ('let's say'); the asides are bone-dry ('I have theories.'). When it matters ('Sometimes the void isn't the scariest thing') the wryness falls away and the voice gets plain and close, almost a whisper, never preachy. Part Two is first person and protective: 'my fear' is said the way you'd say 'my little brother'. Sentence ends fall into silence.
voice_notes.JESUS: Warm, unhurried, playful, never preachy; a gentle tease with laugh lines in his voice. Speaks to the Void like an old friend and to the user like someone sitting on the floor beside them: low, steady, every phrase placed, with real pauses so they can answer. 'Teehee' is a genuine, delighted, slightly sheepish giggle-word. 'That's really meaningful to me' is sincere and almost shy. 'Huh.' and 'Too much eye contact. Apparently.' are dry and fond, never wounded.
voice_notes.USER: Young, quick, gender-ambiguous; sarcasm as armour, and you can hear the armour shaking. Squeaky when scared ('Uh. Sir?'), flat and fast when refusing ('Hell no.', 'Nope.'). 'What the actual f***' is a cracked, high squeak of disbelief. 'I just...' is the only unguarded sound they make, and it stalls.
voice_notes.FEAR: The same small, breathy, high voice from the earlier film; quick to crack; completely sincere. 'What's that noise?' is a startled little squeak; 'Why are you showing me this?' is a whisper of awe.
voice_notes.MAGICIAN: Theatrical, slithery, oily stage-whisper; savours consonants like a showman announcing a trick to an empty theatre. Comic menace, never truly frightening. 'Rude.' is muffled, dazed and deadpan from under a bucket.
voice_notes.VOID: Never says words. Whispers are low, breathy, unintelligible cosmic murmurs with a faint chime in them. The maniacal laugh starts as a booming belly laugh and breaks into wheezes and star-coughs. Giggles are soft and bubbly, like a kettle of stars. Huffs are short, sulky puffs. Hums are deep, warm and low, like a cat purring in a cathedral.

scenes.purpose: A bright, funny-tender first image: a person crying at their phone, a giant starry Void sitting quietly behind them. We recognise the 2 a.m. doomscroll feeling, watch the user bolt from it, and see Jesus arrive, now, and notice. We SEE that the user was crying before they ever saw the Void (Jesus will name this later).

music.mood: wistful hush that tips into a skittering comic chase, then one warm glint
music.instrumentation: felt piano single notes under the phone glow; pizzicato strings and soft marimba for the run; harp glissando and celesta when Jesus appears

beats.shot: OPENING STILL / THUMBNAIL. Frame one is the finished, fully lit image: no fade, nothing fading up. 35mm-feel lens at sitting-eye height, slightly low. Golden dusk over rolling peach, lilac and mint hills; a pale path winds from lower-left up to a huge, low, warm sun on the horizon at frame-left. On the mint crest in the middle of frame the USER sits cross-legged, hunched over a glowing phone (head at y~560). Directly behind them, filling the upper-right half (hood top y~140, base y~760), THE VOID SITS on the grass like an enormous, patient, round guest: indigo velvet with slow stars drifting inside the fabric, violet-to-teal rim glow, the sky above it deepening to indigo with a scatter of stars; its two soft starlight eyes look down at the top of the user's head. Title 'The Void Has a Sense of Humor' in cream, rounded hand-lettering in the warm peach sky upper-left (y~120-250), fully opaque on frame one; it holds through this beat and fades out over the first 1.5 s of the next line. A few glowing thought-seeds drift. Imperceptible 2% push-in. Faces stay inside y 110-850; the subtitle band (y 880-1060) shows only grass, path or floor.
beats.action: Groundwork for say-it-show-it: the user is visibly crying at the phone and has NOT noticed the Void sitting right behind them.

acting.USER: Already in pose on frame one (eyes open, never mid-blink): head bowed 20 degrees to the phone, eyes on the screen, inner brows pinched up, upper lids heavy at 60%, a wet tear track catching the sun on the near cheek, lower lip pushed out a little; right thumb on the glass. At 1.0 s the thumb flicks up once (a scroll); at 1.6 s a small sniff hitches the shoulders.
acting.VOID: Utterly still, sitting, big hands resting on its round middle; eyes soft and curious on the user's cowlick, nebula-brows level. At 1.5 s one slow blink (dark lids slide down over the starlight and back up, 10 frames). One star mote lifts off the hood rim.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So. Let's say there's a Twitter user.
beats.delivery: warm and wry, like starting a bedtime story you're making up as you go; a small breath after 'So.'; a smile in the voice on 'Twitter user'
beats.shot: Hold the opening composition; the push continues while the title finishes fading out.
beats.action: The user scrolls, sniffs and wipes their nose on the hoodie cuff; the Void watches them do it.

acting.USER: Thumb flicks twice; drags the hoodie cuff under the nose; eyes never leave the screen; a slow, wet blink.
acting.VOID: Tilts its hood 6 degrees to one side, like a very large dog trying to understand a phone; its eyes follow the thumb.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Up way too late, ~crying at their phone.
beats.delivery: softer, rueful, the voice of someone who has done this too; 'crying' lands low and plain, without pity
beats.shot: INSERT over the user's shoulder onto the phone (screen y~420-760): a generic social app with a plain speech-bubble icon (no logo, no real names); grey posts with tiny storm-cloud and exclamation-mark icons slide up under the thumb; the clock in the corner reads 2:07 AM.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: a tear drops onto the screen and blooms into a small blur over a grey headline; the thumb scrolls right through it.

acting.USER: Hand and chin edge only: the thumb pauses on the tear, smears it with one swipe and keeps scrolling; a tiny tremor in the hand.

beats.shot: Cut to close-up of the USER (face y~360-620), phone glow cool-white from below, warm dusk rim on the hair.
beats.action: The user feels something behind them.

acting.USER: Eyes lift off the phone first (head still) and lose focus: something feels off. The brows draw together a hair; the eyes slide toward the shoulder; a swallow.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then they turn around... and there's the ~void.
beats.delivery: a storyteller's lean-in on 'turn around', a held breath on the dots, then deadpan, dry as toast, landing low on 'void'
beats.shot: On 'turn around': over-the-shoulder from behind the user's head (cowlick at y~700-850) looking up into the Void's hood (eyes y~260). On 'there's the void': reverse close-up on the USER's face (y~360-620), the Void's out-of-focus starry bulk filling the background.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the user turns and finds the enormous Void right there; caught, the Void gives a small shy wave; the user's face takes it in.

acting.USER: A slow quarter turn of the head; from behind, the head stops dead mid-turn and the shoulders creep up to the ears. In the reverse: pupils shrink to pinpoints; upper lids snap fully open, whites showing above the irises; brows shoot up and pinch together in the middle; the mouth falls slowly open into a silent 'o'; the phone hand freezes in mid-air; breath held.
acting.VOID: Eyes widen (caught being there), nebula-brows lift; a small hopeful closed crescent smile appears in the cosmic dark of the hood as one huge hand lifts and four starlit fingers wiggle once, awkwardly.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.caption: (screams)
beats.shot: Wide side view: the user on the crest, the seated Void beside and behind them, the sun low at frame-left.
beats.action: The user screams and scrambles to their feet, sneakers slipping on the grass.

acting.USER: Mouth squared open; eyes squeezed half shut; elbows flail; scrabbles up, phone clutched to the chest with both hands.
acting.VOID: Flinches back at the scream; the waving hand curls in on itself; the eyes go round.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And they do what most of us do with a feeling that big. They run.
beats.delivery: gentle and knowing, a fond little sigh in it; a beat of comic flatness on 'They run.'
beats.shot: Tracking low-angle from in front of the user as they launch down the path toward camera (face y~380); the Void small on the crest behind.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the user bolts down the path, crying, hoodie strings bouncing, sneakers kicking up glowing seed-fluff.

acting.USER: Running hard and badly: hunched, elbows tight, phone clamped to the sternum; crying openly now, brows high in the middle, mouth pulled wide and down, tears flicking off the cheeks into the light; one glance back over the shoulder.
acting.VOID: On the crest behind: the hand slowly lowers; the nebula-brows sag at the outer edges. Then it rocks forward and stands on its short, fat, round legs (a soft bounce as they take the weight) and takes one plodding, hesitant step after them, a hand half raised: wait.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And then, let's say Jesus shows up. ^Now. Like, today.
beats.delivery: light and mischievous, a storyteller pulling a rabbit out of a hat; a bright lift on 'Now', then a dry aside on 'Like, today'
beats.shot: Cut to a medium-wide at a bend in the path, the warm sun behind; empty for an instant, thought-seeds drifting. On 'Like, today' the user races right past Jesus, left to right, close to camera, a blur of slate-blue hoodie.
beats.action: A soft golden shimmer at the bend, and Jesus is simply there, mid-step, as if he'd been walking this path all along. The crying user runs straight past him without seeing him.

acting.JESUS: Appears in an easy walking pose: robe and terracotta mantle settling, hands loosely clasped behind him, eyes up and taking in the pastel hills with pleasant, unhurried interest; a faint warm rim glow, no halo. As the user whooshes past, his hair stirs; his head turns to follow; the eyebrows lift in surprise, then the inner corners rise: compassion arriving before thought.
acting.USER: Crying, eyes screwed half shut; doesn't see him at all.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And the first thing he sees is this.
beats.delivery: slower and warmer; the voice settles, this is the heart of it
beats.shot: Close-up of JESUS (face y~330-600), 85mm-feel, sun rim on his hair; background: the path and, far up the hill, the Void.
beats.action: Jesus watches the user run, then looks up the hill at the Void plodding after them, and his face changes from concern to recognition.

acting.JESUS: Eyes track the running user down and away (a soft saccade), brows inner-up, lips parted, a small exhale: he sees the tears. Then the eyes travel up the path to the Void. No alarm at all: the brows smooth, the eyes crinkle, and a slow, fond smile grows, like spotting an old friend across a train station.

beats.shot: Long-lens two-shot compressing the path: JESUS in the near mid-ground (lower-left, head y~520), the VOID up the hill (upper-right, eyes y~230); the user, small and far down the path at frame-right, has stopped and turned to look back.
beats.action: Jesus gives the Void a small wave. The Void, surprised, waves back. Down the path, the user sees it.

acting.JESUS: Lifts one hand at chest height: a small, warm, two-finger wave, eyebrows up in greeting.
acting.VOID: Stops mid-plod; two fast blinks; then a shy, stunned little wave back, fingers wiggling, a small crescent smile.
acting.USER: Panting, hands on knees; looks back; freezes. The face says: did he just WAVE at it?

scenes.purpose: Jesus does the thing nobody does: walks right up to the Void, puts his arm around it and whispers in its ear. The user's terror turns comic (they land on their backside). The Void, wary at first, melts into curiosity.

music.instrumentation: pizzicato strings, bassoon, a soft clarinet line, light woodblock

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And then he does the one thing nobody does with the void. He walks right up to it.
beats.delivery: conspiratorial and delighted, building; a little proud of him on the second sentence
beats.shot: Wide from behind JESUS's shoulder looking up the pale path to the Void (eyes y~260), indigo sky above it; on the second sentence cut to a medium-wide on the USER far down the path (head y~430), Jesus and the Void small behind.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: Jesus walks up the path, all the way to the Void, unhurried.

acting.JESUS: Easy stride, shoulders loose, hands open at his sides, mantle swaying; eyes on the Void's eyes the whole way; stops close enough to touch.
acting.VOID: Watches him come: lids lower to a wary half, nebula-brows knit; it shifts its weight from one fat foot to the other.
acting.USER: Straightens up from the pant; eyes go wide, then wider; head pokes forward as if that would help them see.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: Uh. Sir? That's the void.
beats.delivery: fast and squeaky, half whisper, half shout; the politeness of someone watching a stranger walk up to a bear
beats.shot: Close on the USER (face y~380).
beats.action: The user calls up the hill and starts backing away.

acting.USER: Lip-sync. Brows up and pinched; eyes darting between Jesus and the Void; the free hand half raises, fingers spread, a feeble 'stop'; feet already stepping backward.

beats.shot: Medium-wide on the USER, low enough to see the sneakers.
beats.action: The user's heel catches a root; they windmill once and land flat on their backside, one hand flung up in front of them.

acting.USER: Arms windmill; a little yelp-shape with the mouth; the landing jolts the whole body. They stay down, legs out, propped on one elbow, the other hand up, palm out, fingers splayed: a shield against the void. Eyes never leave the hill. They will stay on the ground like this until Jesus kneels to them.

beats.shot: Low angle, 28mm-feel, at Jesus's hip height: JESUS small at frame-bottom-left (head y~600), the VOID towering above him (eyes y~250).
beats.action: Jesus and the Void, face to face. A long look.

acting.VOID: Looks down at him: lids at a guarded half, starlight irises searching his face; nebula-brows low and uncertain; hands held close to its round body; a tiny lean back, like something used to being shooed away.
acting.JESUS: Looks up at it with a warm, open grin; brows lifted, head tilted; a little exhale through the nose: there you are.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He puts his arm around it, and whispers something in its ear.
beats.delivery: tender and unhurried, then lower and playful on 'whispers'
beats.shot: Two-shot, side view; on 'whispers' push in to a tight profile two-shot (faces y~300-520).
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: Jesus slides his arm around the Void; he crooks a finger, the Void bows its great hood down to him, and he cups a hand to his mouth beside it.

acting.JESUS: Steps in, shoulder to its side, arm wrapping around the soft velvet of its lower back as far as it reaches; one flat-palm pat. Then he beckons with a finger, eyes twinkling, and cups a hand at the side of the hood.
acting.VOID: Eyes snap wide (nobody does this); its whole round body goes stiff; a beat later the lids soften, the shoulders drop, the velvet visibly relaxes and a puff of star motes lifts off its rim. Then a slow, deep bow of its whole body to bring the hood down beside his head, eyes sliding toward him, curious.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.caption: (whispering)
beats.shot: Hold the tight profile two-shot.
beats.action: Jesus whispers into the Void's ear; we never hear the words.

acting.JESUS: Lips moving fast behind the cupped hand; eyebrows bobbing as he builds a story; at 1.9 s a pause for effect, eyes wide; then the last bit with a tiny head-waggle.
acting.VOID: Listening, lids lifting slowly; at 1.8 s the eyes go round; at 2.4 s a crescent mouth appears in the dark and quivers at the corners: trying very, very hard not to.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nobody knows what he said. I have ^theories.
beats.delivery: dry, a straight face; the driest line in the film, a tiny pause before 'theories'
beats.shot: Close-up on the Void's hood, front three-quarter (eyes y~330); on 'I have theories' cut to the USER on the ground, the two of them small up the hill.
beats.action: The Void's face is fighting a laugh; the user stares up at it, hand still raised.

acting.VOID: Eyes squeezing into wobbling crescents; the cosmic mouth pressed into a thin line, corners twitching up; stars inside its velvet fizz faster; the round shoulders begin to shake.
acting.JESUS: Edge of frame: straightens with a satisfied, innocent little smile, hands folded.
acting.USER: Hand still up, palm out; a slow, disbelieving blink; head tilts; eyes flick from Jesus to the Void and back.

scenes.purpose: The release: the Void laughs maniacally, coughing up stars and tiny galaxies, and Jesus laughs with it. The scariest thing in the user's night turns out to have the best laugh in the world.

music.instrumentation: celesta runs, glockenspiel sparkles on each star, a bouncy tuba, a timpani roll under the big laugh

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Close on the Void's hood.
beats.action: The laugh leaks out as a snort, and a single star pops out of the hood.

acting.VOID: A tiny convulsion; the crescent mouth bursts open for one frame and a single bright star pops out and floats up; the eyes go wide with alarm at itself.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (maniacal cosmic laughter)
beats.shot: Low-angle wide, 28mm-feel: the Void fills the upper frame (eyes y~220), Jesus at its side (head y~560), indigo sky above; a gentle 8-degree orbit around them during the laugh.
beats.action: The Void throws its hood back and roars with laughter; its whole round body wobbles like jelly; the indigo sky above it sparkles brighter.

acting.VOID: Hood thrown back; crescent mouth wide open, the deep cosmos visible inside; eyes squeezed into upside-down crescents; both huge hands clutching its round belly; fat legs stamping in place; the body shakes in big slow waves; tiny stars fizz off its rim.
acting.JESUS: Laughing along: head back, an open laugh, eyes squeezed; one hand on the Void's side, holding on as it wobbles.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.shot: Same shot.
beats.action: Jesus laughs with it.

acting.JESUS: Shoulders shaking, a hand over his eyes; peeks between his fingers at the Void and laughs harder.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It laughs so hard, it starts coughing up ^stars.
beats.delivery: delighted, picking up speed, a laugh threatening in the narrator's own voice
beats.shot: Medium on the Void's hood, Jesus at frame edge.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: with each cough a burst of bright stars sprays out of the hood and floats up into the dusk.

acting.VOID: Doubles forward, coughing: each hack bursts the crescent mouth open and three or four stars puff out like sparks; eyes watering starlight; a big hand thumps its own chest.
acting.JESUS: Pats the Void's back with a flat palm, the way you help a friend who's choking on a joke, still giggling.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Same shot.
beats.action: Coughs; stars.

acting.VOID: Two hacking coughs, stars spraying out with each.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And little ^galaxies.
beats.delivery: a tiny amazed giggle under 'little'
beats.shot: Follow-pan down as a small spiral galaxy tumbles out of the hood, bounces on the grass and rolls downhill like a dropped coin.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the Void coughs out a tiny spinning spiral galaxy that bounces and rolls away down the path.

acting.VOID: One big cough: a violet-and-gold spiral galaxy the size of a dinner plate shoots out and bounces; the Void's eyes go wide, it reaches after it, and laughs again.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Same follow.
beats.action: One last cough; one last star.

acting.VOID: A small cough; one star floats out.

beats.shot: Low on the grass beside the USER's sneaker (sneaker lower-right at y~800, the user's face upper-middle at y~380 behind it).
beats.action: The little galaxy rolls down, spirals to a stop against the user's sneaker, wobbles like a spun coin and lies down, still twinkling.

acting.USER: Looks down at it. Then, very slowly, looks back up the hill. A slow blink. The raised hand has not lowered an inch.
acting.VOID: Background: still shaking with leftover giggles, wiping one eye.

scenes.purpose: The first punchline. The camera walks in on the user's terror in steps, Jesus looks at them and delivers the line with total sincerity, and the user's answer lands as the Void's laughter fizzles out.

music.mood: comic hold; the music drops almost to silence for the punchline
music.instrumentation: a single pizzicato on each push-in step, one celesta ping on 'Teehee', then nothing

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Meanwhile, the Twitter user is on the ground. One hand up, like that'll help.
beats.delivery: deadpan, then a fond dry tease on 'like that'll help'
beats.shot: Wide on the USER sitting on the grass, legs out (head y~470), the tiny galaxy at the sneaker; on 'One hand up' cut closer, the raised hand in the foreground (hand y~430, face y~350).
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the user on their backside, exactly where they fell, one hand up, fingers splayed and trembling.

acting.USER: Propped on one elbow, legs splayed, frozen; the raised hand trembles; the fingers spread wider, as if that adds protection.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: ~Terror in their eyes.
beats.delivery: low and close, almost a whisper; half mock, half true
beats.shot: Extreme close-up of the USER's eyes (y~380-520): the little galaxy reflected in both irises.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the terrified eyes.

acting.USER: Pupils pinpoint; whites visible all round; lower lids trembling; one eyebrow twitching; no blink at all.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: The void's got a pretty good sense of humor.
beats.delivery: warm, conspiratorial, still bubbling with leftover laughter, like explaining a friend's very loud laugh at a party; unhurried, a lean on 'pretty good'
beats.shot: Medium close on JESUS (face y~380), the Void blurred and giggling behind him.
beats.action: Jesus turns his head down the hill, looks right at the user, and says it, a thumb pointing back over his shoulder at the Void.

acting.JESUS: A last chuckle; a knuckle wipes one eye; the head turns and the eyes find the user and soften. Lip-sync: thumb hooked back over his shoulder; eyebrows up; a crooked, proud little smile; one slow nod on 'pretty good'.
acting.VOID: Behind him, wipes a starry tear with one fingertip; a hiccup of a giggle.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: ^Teehee.
beats.delivery: a genuine, delighted little giggle-word, high and light; shoulders up to his ears; sheepish, like he knows it's a funny word
beats.shot: Hold the medium close.
beats.action: Jesus giggles 'teehee' and scrunches his nose.

acting.JESUS: Lip-sync. Shoulders lift to his ears; nose scrunches; eyes crinkle shut for a moment; fingertips touch his lips and fall away. Then he simply smiles at the user and waits, as if this were a perfectly normal thing to say.

beats.shot: Cut to the USER, medium close (face y~380), hand still up.
beats.action: A blank comic hold on the user's face while, up the hill, the Void's laugh winds down.

acting.USER: Absolutely still. A slow blink. A second, slower blink. The mouth opens a little and closes. The eyes slide to the Void, back to Jesus. One eyebrow begins to rise.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: What the actual f***?!
beats.delivery: a rising, high, cracked squeak of pure disbelief; fast; the bleep lands right on the beat
beats.shot: Hold the USER close.
beats.action: The user says it just as the Void's laughter finally fizzles out.

acting.USER: Lip-sync. The raised hand finally drops to flap once at the whole situation; both eyebrows shoot up; the head juts forward on 'actual'; eyes bulging.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.shot: Cut to a medium on the Void and Jesus.
beats.action: The Void's last giggles wheeze out, and it composes itself.

acting.VOID: A final little giggle, shoulders bobbing; a long exhale; it straightens its hood with both hands, the way you fix your hair after laughing too hard; the eyes settle to a calm half.
acting.JESUS: Smiling up at it, delighted, one hand still resting on its side.

scenes.purpose: The tables turn: now the Void whispers to Jesus, side-eyeing the user. The comedy of being gossiped about, and under it the first hint that the Void has feelings too: being run from hurts. The user overhears.

music.mood: sneaky, conspiratorial, then a sudden soft sincerity
music.instrumentation: muted pizzicato, bass clarinet, a woodblock tick; a single warm cello note on 'hurts'

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: When the void is done laughing, it whispers into Jesus's ear.
beats.delivery: light and sly
beats.shot: Medium profile two-shot; push in to tight as the Void bends; the user a tiny blur far downhill between their faces.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the Void bends down, cups a huge hand beside its hood, and starts whispering into Jesus's ear.

acting.VOID: A slow lean down; one big four-fingered hand cups at the side of its hood toward Jesus's ear; the crescent mouth moves in the dark.
acting.JESUS: Tilts his head toward it, ear first, eyebrows up: go on.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (cosmic whispering)
beats.shot: Hold the tight profile; a slow rack of focus to the user far downhill and back.
beats.action: Say-it-show-it: the Void whispers and, the whole time, side-eyes the user.

acting.VOID: Whispering. At 0.8 s, without turning its hood, the starlight eyes slide all the way to the corner toward the user; the lower lids lift into a suspicious squint; one nebula-brow cocks up. Back to Jesus. At 2.6 s, side-eye again, longer.
acting.JESUS: Listens with his whole face: small nods, eyebrows bobbing, lips pressed in a polite, suppressed smile.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.shot: Same.
beats.action: Jesus nods along.

acting.JESUS: Two small nods, 'mm-hm', eyes lowered, listening.

beats.speaker: USER
beats.text: Oh, great. Now it's gossiping about me.
beats.delivery: flat and sarcastic, a little wounded; muttered to themselves, too loud
beats.shot: Cut to the USER on the ground, medium (face y~380).
beats.action: The user watches the whispering, offended and scared at once.

acting.USER: Lip-sync. Eyes narrowed, darting between the two; pulls the phone to the chest like a shield; chin tucked; the mouth twists to one side.

beats.speaker: VOID
beats.caption: (whispering)
beats.shot: Back to the profile two-shot.
beats.action: The Void keeps whispering, slower and lower; this part is not a joke.

acting.VOID: The whisper slows; the side-eye toward the user softens into something hurt: lids droop at the outer corners, nebula-brows tilt up in the middle; the stars inside its velvet dim slightly.
acting.JESUS: His face changes: the suppressed smile fades; the brows draw together; his eyes lift to the Void's with full attention; a slower nod.

beats.speaker: JESUS
beats.text: No, I know. That ~hurts.
beats.delivery: quiet and sincere, the joke gone from his voice; spoken to the Void, not meant for the user
beats.shot: Close on JESUS, the hood edge in the foreground.
beats.action: Jesus answers the Void softly, a hand on its velvet.

acting.JESUS: Lip-sync, barely above a murmur. Inner brows up; eyes glistening a little; a hand rises to rest flat on the Void's velvet.
acting.VOID: Hood edge in the foreground: one small, slow nod.
